title: Optimizing check for PA eligibility
summary: The Payables Agent eligibility check now uses a more efficient query strategy to avoid unnecessary slowdowns when opening the Purchase Invoice page by leveraging an existing database index on Posting Date instead of relying on systemCreatedAt.
key_points: New query created to check PA eligibility based on Posting Date instead of systemCreatedAt
Uses an existing database key to filter records before determining user eligibility
Reduces SQL retrieval load by limiting results through the query
Improves page opening performance for users in AP processes
Heuristic trades some accuracy for consistent time-bounded performance
